_meta.definition: The process of managing geolocation data and airport information

airport._description: Captures unique identifiers and codes for global airports along with their respective names.

columns.name: airport_id
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in airport

columns.name: iata
columns.description: Stores three-letter IATA codes for airports.

columns.name: icao
columns.description: Stores 4-character ICAO codes identifying airports worldwide.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of airport names, including spaces and special characters.

airport_geo._description: Captures geographical details of airports, including airport ID, name, city, country, latitude, longitude, and geolocation.

columns.name: airport_id
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in airport_geo

columns.name: name
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of airport names, often including location identifiers.

columns.name: city
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of airport city names, such as A CORUNA, BELLE PLAINE, TIARET, DIRE DAWA, CHUNCHON.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of country names for airports.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Stores geographical latitude coordinates for airport locations.

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Stores geographical longitudes of airports in decimal degrees.

columns.name: geolocation
columns.description: Stores Base64-encoded WKB geometries representing airport locations.
